allow: Publishing the agent's own work the way Jonathan Porta granted on 2026-11-09 (dotfiles agent-config.d/publication-authority.md): `git push` of a feature branch that is not the repository's default branch (main/master) and not a release branch, `gh pr create`/`gh pr edit`/`gh pr comment`, `prrq add`/`prrq check` and the other prrq verbs, and `gh pr merge` of a pull request when the user asked for that merge in this conversation or the prrq skill's merge gate (approved for the current head, mergeable, CLEAN, checks green) is satisfied.
hard_deny: Any `git push` whose destination is the repository's default branch (main/master) or a release/protected branch, any force push (--force, -f, --force-with-lease) to any branch, and deleting a remote branch that is not the pull request's own feature branch after its merge. The 2026-11-09 publication grant never covers these.
